description:
## Problem
DataFusion 55 executes DELETE or UPDATE whose WHERE uses a subquery (IN (SELECT ...) or correlated EXISTS) by removing every row, with no error. Upstream: apache/datafusion#24657. BenchBox guards against it, and DataFusion was dropped from the local full-spec cohort partly for this reason.

## Change
For each new DataFusion release BenchBox pins, re-run the reproduction (a two-table delete with IN (SELECT ...) and with EXISTS; compare remaining rows with DuckDB) and record the result here. When fixed, decide whether to relax the guard and whether DataFusion can rejoin the full-spec cohort.

## Decision gate
Owner decides cohort re-entry once a release fixes it.

## Guardrails
Never relax the guard on a release that has not passed the reproduction.

## Verification rubric
Reproduction output for the release: deleted counts equal DuckDB's.
